fullPassage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.

questions.passage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 의미 있는 일이 더 행복한 삶으로 이어진다는 글 전체 논지를 포괄하는 제목
det.analysis:
❌ ① The Hidden Costs of Overworking(과로의 숨겨진 대가): 과로의 부정적 대가가 아닌 의미 있는 일의 긍정적 효과를 다룸

❌ ② How to Earn a Higher Income Fast(빠르게 소득 버는 법): 소득은 결과의 하나일 뿐 돈 버는 법이 핵심이 아님

✅ ③ Seeking Purpose at a Job Brings Real Joy(일에서 목적을 추구하는 것이 주는 진정한 기쁨): 일에서 의미를 찾는 것이 성취감·성과·소득을 거쳐 더 행복한 삶으로 이어진다는 글의 핵심을 포괄 ←정답

❌ ④ The Global Decline of Job Satisfaction(직업 만족도의 하락): 만족도 하락이 아니라 만족의 이점을 다룸
det.tip: 글의 핵심 = 의미 있는 일 → 삶의 행복

questions.passage: It would be <u>hard to overstate</u> how important meaningful work is to human beings— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 hard to overstate가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 'hard to overstate' = 과장하기 어렵다 = 아무리 강조해도 지나치지 않을 만큼 매우 중요하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 부풀려 말하기 쉽다: overstate(과장하다)가 hard(어렵다)와 결합해 '과장하기 어렵다'는 뜻이므로 반대

❌ ② 근거가 부족하다: 중요성의 정도를 말하는 표현으로, 근거 유무와 무관

❌ ③ 쉽게 잊어버린다: 망각이 아니라 중요성의 크기를 강조하는 표현

✅ ④ 아무리 강조해도 지나치지 않을 만큼 중요하다: 'hard to overstate how important ...'는 '얼마나 중요한지 과장하기 어렵다' 즉 '지극히 중요하다'는 강조 표현이므로 부합 ←정답
det.tip: hard to overstate = 과장하기 어렵다 = 극도로 중요하다

ch: 그 중요성을 실제보다 부풀려 말하기 쉽다
그 중요성을 입증할 과학적 근거가 부족하다
아무리 강조해도 지나치지 않을 만큼 중요하다

Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, <u>they</u> not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 'when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce ...'에서 they는 직장에서 더 성취감을 느끼는 사람들(people)을 가리킴
det.analysis:
✅ ① 직장에서 더 성취감을 느끼는 사람들: 밑줄 바로 앞 'when people are more fulfilled on the job'의 people을 받으므로 적절 ←정답

❌ ② 심리학 교수들: Sonya Lyubomirsky는 연구를 수행한 사람으로, 성과를 내는 주체(they)가 아님

❌ ③ 연구자들: 연구를 진행한 쪽이지 성취감을 느껴 성과를 내는 주체가 아님

❌ ④ 의미를 찾지 못한 근로자들: they는 오히려 성취감을 느끼는(fulfilled) 사람들을 가리킴
det.tip: they = 바로 앞 people who are more fulfilled on the job

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: '자신의 경력에서 더 깊은 의미(deeper meaning in their careers)' — 그런 사람들이 나날을 더 활력 있게 느낀다는 흐름
det.analysis:
❌ ① higher salaries at their companies(더 높은 급여): 급여가 아닌 '의미'를 찾은 결과 활력을 느낀다는 글의 초점과 어긋남

✅ ② deeper meaning in their careers(경력에서 더 깊은 의미): 'Those who have found __________ find their days much more energizing and satisfying'에서 의미 있는 일이 활력·만족으로 이어진다는 글 전체 논지와 부합 ←정답

❌ ③ shorter hours in their workplaces(더 짧은 근무 시간): 근무 시간 단축은 본문에서 다루지 않음

❌ ④ less pressure from their managers(상사의 더 적은 압박): 압박 감소는 본문 내용과 무관
det.tip: 글의 핵심어 meaningful work → deeper meaning in their careers

questions.passage: Those most __________ (satisfy) with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. Those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 'Those most satisfied' = 가장 만족한 사람들, 수동·상태를 나타내는 과거분사 satisfied
det.analysis: 'Those (who are) most __________ with their work'에서 명사 Those를 수식하며 '~에 만족한'이라는 수동·상태의 의미를 나타내는 자리이므로 동사 satisfy를 과거분사 satisfied로 바꾼다. be satisfied with(~에 만족하다) 구조의 과거분사. satisfy → satisfied
det.tip: be satisfied with ~ = ~에 만족하다. 감정 수동태는 과거분사(satisfied)
